'''Heaven''' can refer to the following:

* [[Circuit of Heaven]] - a horse racetrack just north of [[Ebou Dar]].
* ''[[The Fires of Heaven]]'' - the fifth book of ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series.
* [[Fists of Heaven]] - an elite [[Seanchan]] military group.
* [[The Gates of Heaven]] - an inn in [[Canluum]].
* [[The Golden Crown of Heaven]] - an inn in the [[Rahad]] district of Ebou Dar.
* [[The Golden Swans of Heaven]] - an inn in Ebou Dar.
